scope: Mechanical confidence bookkeeping only; no source/context inspection, reading inference, or new confidence judgment. Cached diagnostic filename-map metadata was used for the safe rebuild.
rule: Preserve the existing direct-final comparison first, including its boundary-whitespace trimming.
For an otherwise pending entry, require decision final to equal C retained exactly and compare its c field only to the complete literal unsure macro.
Exact retained-C matching requires exactly one candidate decision and exactly one matching macro occurrence on that page.
Fallback normalization collapses whitespace runs to one space and trims both ends. It preserves every nonspace character and does not delete an internal whitespace separator.
Normalized matching also requires exactly one candidate decision and exactly one matching occurrence across the whole page.
Copy only the matched record's existing high/medium/low value. Invalid, unmatched, or ambiguous cases remain not assessed; never use fuzzy similarity.
